task: SPEC-049/T014 (D2 cap scope): whether the D2 maxNativeUnits cap of 16 is counted per cohort
decisionChannel: Founder answer to an interactive guided question in the HAR orchestrator session, 2026-11-17, recorded verbatim (answer as chosen). Additive; the 2026-10-31 D2 caps record stays as written and its values are unchanged.
question: Whether SPEC-048/T008 units count toward the D2 cap of 16 native units, or the cap applies per cohort (open item of t014-readiness.md, plan P2: 5 holdout cases x arms A/B/C = 15 native units)

decision.reading: maxNativeUnits 16 of the 2026-10-31 D2 caps applies to each native cohort on its own. Units of the SPEC-048/T008 cohort do not count toward the SPEC-049/T014 cohort, so plan P2 (15 native units) fits within 16. The value 16 is kept. The other D2 caps (30 min per unit, at most 10 % of the 5-hour window per session, at most 15 % of the weekly window per cohort, weekly stop above 80 %, EUR 0) are unchanged; this answer does not change how they are counted.
decision.codeChange: none: D2Caps and MAX_UNITS are unchanged; scripts/har_t008_unit.py keeps its own founder cap of 4 for the SPEC-048/T008 cohort.

limits: Settles only how the unit cap is counted. Admits no native cohort (SPEC-049/T004 still required), freezes no arm, sets no T014 window and records no outcome.
